# FastSpeech + HiFi-GAN (xcmyz, Grad-TTS study)

Grad-TTS authors / Huawei Noah · released 2021-05

Unofficial xcmyz FastSpeech implementation used by the Grad-TTS authors, coupled with HiFi-GAN; not the original Microsoft FastSpeech checkpoint. Exact trained weights not verified.

[Model and usage documentation](https://github.com/xcmyz/FastSpeech)

[Catalogue source](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v139/popov21a/popov21a.pdf)

Published measurements are available, but there is not enough shared evaluation data to calculate a comparable overall score yet.
